de: Formally, Ukraine and NATO countries have already created situations in which Russia allows the possibility of a nuclear strike. This statement was made on November 23 by Deputy Chairman of the Security Council of Russia Dmitry Medvedev. He added that Moscow was in such situations…

te: Air defense forces shot down 819 Ukrainian UAVs and HIMARS shell during the day
de: Air defense systems destroyed 819 Ukrainian drones and a HIMARS projectile during the day. This was reported on November 23 in the Ministry of Defense of Russia. The news is supplemented.
